Class WebSocketRouteEndpoint

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.websocket.WebSocketRouteEndpoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
WebSocketBean<Object>
@Internal public final class WebSocketRouteEndpoint extends Object implements WebSocketBean<Object>
The endpoint of a WebSocket route: a WebSocketBean whose methods are the handler functions a WebSocketEndpointSpec declared. The route builder adds a GET route that carries it as the attribute ROUTE_ATTRIBUTE and has the annotations ROUTE_METADATA, which make it a WebSocket route: the server upgrades a request to it and hands the connection to this endpoint instead of to a bean looked up by type.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • connected

      public void connected(WebSocketSession session, Executor executor, Consumer<Throwable> errors)
      A connection opened, before its open handler is called.
      Parameters:
      session - The session of the connection
      executor - Runs the handlers of the route like the server does, on its executor, with the upgrade request as the current request: the messages handler once an asynchronous open handler is done, and the signals to the subscriber of the stream of the messages
      errors - Handles an error of the connection outside of its handlers, e.g. of the stage of its WebSocketMessageStreamHandler, like the error of a handler

    • connected

      public void connected(WebSocketSession session, Executor executor, Consumer<Throwable> errors, Consumer<Object> release)
      A connection opened, before its open handler is called.
      Parameters:
      session - The session of the connection
      executor - Runs the handlers of the route, see connected(WebSocketSession, Executor, Consumer)
      errors - Handles an error of the connection outside of its handlers
      release - Releases a message of the stream of the messages that no subscriber receives, e.g. a reference counted buffer of the server

    • disconnected
